policies.missing_values: No imputation; fail if X10 is missing or non-finite.
policies.outliers: No automatic deletion, clipping, or winsorization.
policies.scale_sensitive_models: StandardScaler fitted within the allowed training fold only.
policies.robust_scaler: Sensitivity candidate only; if selected by performance, tune inside inner CV.
policies.pca: Not part of main X10 pipeline; optional fold-local ablation/resource experiment.
policies.class_balance: No over/undersampling in preprocessing; handle with model-side weighting and metrics.
policies.cv: Reuse frozen STRICT_CV_FOLD assignments; never regenerate for favorable performance.
policies.test: Never fit transformations on TEST; historical TEST labels are not used during preprocessing.
policies.kernel_fairness: Matched classical and quantum kernels receive the same preprocessed coordinates.
